title: "MATLAB Resources"

A short list of references beyond the [textbook](textbook.qmd). More to come.

## MATLAB

- [Installing MATLAB](installing_matlab.qmd) for this course.
- [MATLAB Onramp](https://matlabacademy.mathworks.com/details/matlab-onramp/gettingstarted): MathWorks' free two-hour interactive introduction.
- [Plain-text live code format](https://www.mathworks.com/help/matlab/matlab_prog/plain-text-file-format-for-live-scripts.html): the `.m` live-script format used for all assignments in this course.
- [Format text in the Live Editor](https://www.mathworks.com/help/matlab/matlab_prog/format-live-scripts.html).

## Other introductory programming courses

The collaboration policy in the [syllabus](../syllabus.qmd#collaboration-and-use-of-generative-ai) borrows from these courses, which are also good models of how to learn programming.

- [Harvard CS50's Introduction to Programming with Python](https://cs50.harvard.edu/python/2022/)
- [USNA IC210](https://www.usna.edu/Users/cs/choi/ic210/resources/index.html)
